title: PubSubMessage
description: What the collector publishes to Pub/Sub for each accepted event, ping, withdrawal signal or tag error, and the processor re-validates: the client's payload as received, and the fields the collector derives. The client's IP address is never part of it. A tag error's message (AAI-1142) carries none of the derived geo or user-agent fields, device_class included, which every other message needs.

schema_version.description: The wire schema's major version: this file's.

received_at.description: When the collector received the payload, by the server's clock: Unix epoch milliseconds.

region.description: The data region that collected it, such as europe-west1.

country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country derived from the client's IP address, when one could be; the address itself is dropped.

subdivision.description: The ISO 3166-2 subdivision derived from the client's IP address, when one could be, such as SE-AB. Set on an event's message only: never on a ping's, which carries country-level geo only (06 §3), nor a withdrawal signal's or a tag error's, which dependentSchemas refuses (AAI-1148).

city.description: The city derived from the client's IP address, by the geo database's English name, such as Stockholm: only for a site that turned city-level geo on (its ⚖️ setting, off by default, which the site's config publishes as geo.city), and only when one could be. Set on an event's message only: never on a ping's, which carries country-level geo only (06 §3), nor a withdrawal signal's or a tag error's, which dependentSchemas refuses (AAI-1144).

browser_family.description: The browser family the collector parses from the user agent, such as Chrome or Firefox, when it could. Set on an event's message only, which dependentSchemas enforces (AAI-1148).

browser_major.description: The browser's major version the collector parses from the user agent, when it could. Set on an event's message only, which dependentSchemas enforces (AAI-1148).

os_family.description: The operating system family the collector parses from the user agent, such as Windows or iOS, when it could. Set on an event's message only, which dependentSchemas enforces (AAI-1148).

is_bot.description: Set, as true, when the collector marked the payload a bot's (a known-bot User-Agent, its heuristics, or the batch's webdriver flag, 03 §5, AAI-76): stored, but excluded from aggregates and dashboards by default. Absent otherwise: the collector never sends false. Set on an event's or a ping's message only, never on a withdrawal signal's or a tag error's, which dependentSchemas refuses (AAI-1001). It is server-derived, so a ping's client field list (ping.json) doesn't change.

seq.description: The seq of the event batch the event came in (batch.json), which the processor stores with it so that a job can count each pageload's missing batches (AAI-106). Set on an event's message only, never on a ping's, a withdrawal signal's or a tag error's, which dependentSchemas refuses (AAI-1146).

page_id.description: The page_id of the event batch the event came in (batch.json), when the batch carried one: the pageload whose seq gaps the processor counts (AAI-106). Set on an event's message only, never on a ping's, a withdrawal signal's or a tag error's, which dependentSchemas refuses (AAI-1146).

event.description: The client's payload: an event, an anonymous ping, a withdrawal signal (POST /v1/w, AAI-785), on which the processor erases the visitor's stored data, or a tag error (POST /v1/t, AAI-1142) that names its site, without its message (PublishedTagError). A withdrawal signal's message, like a ping's, leaves off the subdivision, city, browser family and major and OS family: the erasure needs none of them (AAI-1148). A tag error's message carries no geo or user-agent field at all.

DeviceClass.description: The coarse device class the collector derives from the user agent.

PublishedTagError.description: A tag error (tag-error.json) as the collector publishes it, for the processor to store for the realtime debugger (AAI-1130): only one that names its site, and never its message (amandatracker's 08 §4.1).

schema_version.description: The wire schema's major version: this file's.

event_id.description: The tag error's event_id, which the processor stores it under once.

site_id.description: The site the tag was installed for: the collector publishes no tag error without one.
